purpose: Record the bounded Milestone B deterministic GitHub App witness-publication and full provider-fingerprint readback invariants together with current pull-request Playwright stale-base containment, without claiming bootstrap authority, founder-final approval, merge authority, deployment authority, live provider enforcement, secret installation, database authority, or runtime trigger activation.

claims: src/review/deterministicReviewProducer.ts must classify the executable FCR merge-authentication chain as deterministic trust root: founder authentication/session authority, portfolio-switch gating/state resolution, V10 privileged capability validation, V10 decision authority, founder-control decision binding, approvals execution, and the server mount; changes to those paths must produce P1 trust-root-self-modification instead of self-certification.

src/review/deterministicReviewProducer.ts must cover direct merge-authority decision modules as well as middleware wrappers, including founderSession, switchboard store, capabilityKernel, v10DecisionAuthorityGate, and founderControlDecision, while avoiding a transitive trust-root expansion into generic storage or transport clients.

src/review/deterministicReviewProducer.ts must treat the specialized proof-gate decision/persistence/classification chain as merge authority because ProofGateController, proof-gate/gate, proof-gate/persist, and proof-gate/types determine whether merge requires explicit founder approval and whether /approvals/:missionId/execute observes a fresh persisted passing proof; changes to those modules must produce P1 trust-root-self-modification.

src/review/deterministicReviewProducer.ts must treat the deployed Worker entry configuration, Worker cron/handler/reconciler owners, controller base, and every currently reconciler-registered controller as P1 autonomous execution trust root because those surfaces can schedule or dispatch consequential repository work. A new controller cannot become live through the reconciler without changing the protected registry, and the production Worker entry cannot change without modifying the protected Wrangler entry configuration.

src/review/deterministicReviewProducer.ts must also fail closed with P1 new-provider-integration-sink when a candidate introduces RepositoryProvider.integrate in previously unprotected non-test production source. This is a backstop against inventing a new merge executor outside today's path allowlist; ordinary read-only provider calls such as resolveRef remain non-P1 unless they touch an otherwise protected authority path.

src/review/deterministicReviewWitnessPublisher.ts may publish only a clear deterministic receipt produced from provider-observed PR/base/head/diff truth through the repository provider's narrow witness capability, must bind pre/post publication PR identity and exact head, and must reject success unless provider readback reports the exact derived signal, the full receipt reviewHash as evidenceFingerprint, and the server-owned numeric GITHUB_APP_ID.

src/review/independentReviewGate.ts must treat a founder-final deterministic witness as current only when exact head, receipt-derived signal name, passed status, trusted GitHub App issuer, and the provider-backed full evidenceFingerprint all match the exact deterministic review receipt; missing or same-prefix-but-different full fingerprints fail closed.

src/providers/DeterministicReviewGitHubProvider.ts must reject a noncanonical runtime GitHub API base during construction before inherited provider PR/ref/compare reads can use the App installation token; custom bases are test-only with an explicit injected transport. It must also preserve success-only Check Run semantics and GitHub external_id as the full evidenceFingerprint on readback.

src/providers/RepositoryProvider.ts exposes only a narrow optional deterministic-review witness publication capability rather than ambient generic Check Run authority, carries an optional provider-backed evidenceFingerprint for exact evidence correlation, and requires consumers to fail closed when a load-bearing fingerprint or witness capability is unavailable.

src/providers/providerFactory.ts must expose deterministic review witness publication for Founder Control Room only when GITHUB_APP_ID plus GITHUB_PRIVATE_KEY mint the repository-scoped GitHub App installation token; a local or development GITHUB_TOKEN fallback cannot mint deterministic review evidence, and a partial GitHub App credential pair must fail closed even when a fallback token is present.

.github/workflows/playwright.yml must bind pull-request Playwright proof to the exact candidate head and the base SHA carried by the same pull-request event, require that base to be an ancestor of the head before dependency installation or candidate-dependent proof, fail closed with STALE_BASE when ancestry does not hold, and never treat rerunning a historical workflow event as renewed current-base evidence.
